request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: On-chain treasury withdrawal directly to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus compensation for lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled "Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -" was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, causing the submitter to be unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal states there was significant community sentiment that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The requested withdrawal is 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The recipient has not previously received Cardano treasury funds.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal says distribution can be audited on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The referenced external URI points to an AdaStat governance page for the prior governance action.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse a prior Info governance action deposit and claimed lost staking rewards, but most core justification is asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
